citation: Jiu's Sharing Station, "China Payment, Parcel & Security Rules", checked 2026-11-10, https://jiunotes.top/en/life/
note: Every entry carries the official source that states it and the date it was last checked. Rules and figures change without announcement; compare checked_on against your travel date.

facts.claim_en: Static QR-code payment: a single customer's bank accounts and payment accounts combined are capped at 500 CNY per day

source.name: 中国人民银行《条码支付业务规范（试行）》

facts.claim_en: QR-code payment verified with fewer than two authentication factors: capped at 1000 CNY per day

source.name: 中国人民银行《条码支付业务规范（试行）》

facts.claim_en: QR-code payment verified with two or more factors (no digital certificate or e-signature): capped at 5000 CNY per day

source.name: 中国人民银行《条码支付业务规范（试行）》

facts.claim_en: RMB cash is the most basic means of payment in China; no unit or individual may refuse it

source.name: 中国人民银行公告〔2020〕第18号

facts.claim_en: WeChat Pay with a foreign card: 6500 CNY per transaction, 50000 CNY per month, 65000 CNY per year

source.name: 腾讯官方客服·微信支付外卡绑定和使用指南

facts.claim_en: WeChat Pay foreign-card transaction fee: free up to 200 CNY per transaction, 3% above 200 CNY

source.name: 腾讯官方客服·微信支付外卡绑定和使用指南

facts.claim_en: Alipay with a foreign card: 3000 CNY per transaction, 50000 CNY per month, 60000 CNY per year

source.name: 中国民航网·境外旅客支付问答（据支付宝官方外卡指引）

facts.claim_en: Foreign-card cash withdrawal at an ATM in China: no more than 3000 CNY per transaction

source.name: 中国民航网·境外旅客支付问答（据支付宝官方外卡指引）

facts.claim_en: China's prohibited-items list for postal and express shipments has 19 categories

source.name: 国家邮政局《禁止寄递物品指导目录》

facts.claim_en: Real-name registration for parcels: senders must show a valid ID; a foreign citizen's passport is accepted

source.name: 《邮件快件实名收寄管理办法》

facts.claim_en: Express companies must deliver to the agreed address, recipient or designated recipient, and tell them to inspect in person

source.name: 《快递暂行条例》（2019 修订）

facts.claim_en: Without the user's consent, a courier may not confirm receipt on their behalf or drop the parcel into a smart locker or station box (fines up to 30000 CNY)

source.name: 交通运输部《快递市场管理办法》2023年第22号

facts.claim_en: Senders must truthfully state the name, nature and quantity of the item on the waybill

source.name: 《快递暂行条例》（2019 修订）

facts.claim_en: Power banks and lithium batteries are banned from checked luggage; up to 100 Wh may be carried on board, 100-160 Wh needs airline approval (max 2 pieces), above 160 Wh is banned

source.name: 中国民用航空局·航空旅行常识

facts.claim_en: Cigarette lighters, matches and other ignition sources are banned from both carry-on and checked luggage on flights

source.name: 中国民用航空局·航空旅行常识

facts.claim_en: Alcoholic drinks with an alcohol content above 70% by volume are banned from air transport

source.name: 中国民用航空局·航空旅行常识

facts.claim_en: From 28 June 2025, power banks without a clear CCC mark, or with an unclear or recalled mark, are banned on domestic flights

source.name: 中国民航网（民航局通知，首都机场落实）

facts.claim_en: China SIM/phone real-name registration: network entry requires a valid ID; a foreign citizen's passport is accepted

source.name: 《电话用户真实身份信息登记规定》（工信部令第25号）

facts.claim_en: For online, phone and mail-order purchases, the consumer may return within 7 days of receiving the item without giving a reason

source.name: 《中华人民共和国消费者权益保护法》第二十五条

facts.claim_en: Online shopping users in China reached 974 million by December 2024, 87.9% of all internet users

source.name: 中国互联网络信息中心（CNNIC）第55次报告

facts.claim_en: Online travel booking users in China reached 548 million by December 2024, 49.5% of internet users

source.name: 中国互联网络信息中心（CNNIC）第55次报告

facts.claim_en: Food-delivery drone routes in China exceeded 53 by the end of 2024 (more than 50)

source.name: 中国互联网络信息中心（CNNIC）第55次报告

facts.claim_en: China's internet users reached 1.108 billion by December 2024, a 78.6% penetration rate

source.name: 中国互联网络信息中心（CNNIC）第55次报告

facts.claim_en: 5G base stations built in China: 4.191 million by November 2024

source.name: 中国互联网络信息中心（CNNIC）第55次报告

facts.claim_en: For the wider picture, the National Bureau of Statistics publishes the official retail price index, which is the number to check if you want to know whether a price you paid was high for the month or just high for the shop.

source.name: www.stats.gov.cn
